notes: SR116 Maisons du Monde BE (Dutch/Flemish locale, BE/nl). Access: Tier 1 (plain requests) and Tier 2 (Playwright/CDP) both independently re-confirmed 403 DataDome block on this session (matching prior pass and the FR sibling SR96 precedent exactly - homepage and category pages both blocked, robots.txt fetch itself also DataDome-blocked). Escalated to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome) which reached the live site successfully. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow per the prior pass's one successful grace-window fetch (no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web entries) - carried forward, not re-verified this session since robots.txt itself 403s under automation. Main nav has a top-level 'BESTSELLERS' item. Clicking it opens a mega-menu whose breadcrumb-linked parent category is titled 'Onze must-haves van dit moment' (lit. 'Our must-haves of the moment' - the site's own Dutch label for this bestseller/must-have merchandising concept), with 7 genuine child listings (Meubels/Furniture, Decoratie/Decoration, Textiel/Textile, Tuin/Garden, Verlichting/Lighting, Zetels en fauteuils/Sofas and armchairs, Bedden hoofdeindes en nachtkastjes/Beds headboards and nightstands), each a real distinct PLP with its own product count (verified via fresh full-page navigation + SSR-embedded HTML text 'Je hebt 40 van de N producten bekeken' / 'N artikelen', not client-side SPA transitions which showed a stale-count bug when navigating via in-page link clicks). Sum of children (786) is less than parent total (919), consistent with overlap/uncategorized items, not an error. No other bestseller-labeled pages found in footer or sitemap discovery beyond this nav branch. All qty values are exact site-reported counts from the products-viewed / artikelen counter, not estimates.
